description: Negative controls for V1-02-KEY-CORTEX-FAILCLOSED: the KeyCortex parsed-command autonomy fail-closed correction ported from KF-EXEC-AUTH-FAIL-CLOSED-001 (#155, 26c10943) and applied to both processQuery and streamQuery, and the BatchResult mapper ported from #182 (91996b9c), consumed without legacy replay. Each control restores one defect in key-cortex-query-pipeline.service.ts or key-cortex-batch-result.mapper.ts and names the tests that must then fail. Run with node scripts/proof-admission/negative-controls.mjs --manifest scripts/proof-admission/manifests/auth-fail-closed-001-negative-controls.json; the proof is a unit suite and needs no database. The clean-tree half (every named test passes at HEAD) is judged by node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only auth-fail-closed-001-negative-controls.json.
notes: The #155 parsed-command block is ported into one private method, evaluateParsedCommandAutonomy, called by processQuery (STEP_5_CHECK_AUTONOMY evidence as at 26c10943) and by streamQuery before executeBatch (the stream path had no autonomy evaluation at f5c93ba0). The #155 controls are kept with their ids and claims; their find strings are re-anchored to the method's indentation and variable name (executable for autonomyCheckedCommands).
The #155 executeBatch fixture answered an array; the executor answers a BatchResult and #182's mapper rejects the array as an invalid envelope, so the ported fixture answers a real BatchResult.
Every one of the 12 #182 mapper cases is named by at least one control, so the clean-tree half requires each to pass at HEAD (#182's body says they never ran).

Review repair (SEC-V102-1, SEC-V102-2, CR-V102-1): processQuery takes the legacy route only when no parsed command was evaluated; the commands the gate keeps from the executor are settled without executing them (approval-required through the executor approval flow, denied and failed-closed as refusals), each with one ai_execution_logs row through logExecution; streamQuery logs STREAM_CHECK_AUTONOMY and yields a follow-up delta for each one. NC-AUTH-FC-P06 and NC-V102-STREAM-NO-AUTONOMY-GATE are re-anchored to autonomyEvidence() and toStreamConnectorCommand; six NC-V102R controls are added.
